thread:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: metering-service - increased 5xx rate and delayed usage aggregation for billing window. Impact: usage display stale for ~2h, invoices may be delayed. Linking runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/metering-runbook
Oncall Pager: Acknowledged. Jumping in now.
Alice K: I'm on the aggregation pipeline (meter-agg). Seeing a backlog in the SQS queue and multiple connector timeouts to the events-store.
Ben T: I can look at the event-store cluster (events-db) metrics. Any error logs from meter-agg?
Carla M: I have a partial stacktrace from the connector: `ConnectionTimeout: read timeout after 10s` repeated. Also CPU spike on the agg workers. Posting logs: ```[2026-03-14T21:14:03Z] meter-agg ERROR connector failed: ConnectionTimeout```
Dmitri R: Reached rate limit on events-store from meter-agg due to retry storm. We should throttle retries and drain backlog. I can add a temporary rate-limiter to the aggregator config.
Oncall Pager: Action plan: 1) Reduce meter-agg concurrency to 2, 2) Pause non-critical retry loops, 3) Backfill backlog via safe-batch job after stabilization. Who can patch config?
Alice K: Pushing a config change to reduce concurrency now. PR: https://stash.redwood.ai/changes/9832 - will patch live with canary.
Ben T: I'll scale up events-db read replicas by +2 to absorb load. Performing scale-up.
Carla M: Noted. I've paused the retry actor. Logs show retries dropping immediately.
Incident Bot: Status update posted to internal incident channel. Severity: Sev2. Customers impacted: some accounts see "usage last updated 2+ hours ago" on Dashboard; invoices scheduled within next 24h might be delayed.
Eve (Support): I'm drafting an external customer note. Do we have a final impact list? At minimum we should notify billing contacts for Enterprise customers with invoices due in the next 48h.
Product Ops: Please prepare a short status page post. Minimal wording: users may see stale usage and delayed invoices; mitigation in progress; more updates in 30m.
Alice K: Canary config applied to 1/4 workers, no regressions for 5m. Proceeding full rollout.
Dmitri R: events-db scale succeeded, backlog drain rate improved 3x. Starting safe-batch backfill with rate limit.
Ben T: Confirming: no new 5xx errors after throttle + scale. Monitoring for 15m before marking mitigated.
Carla M: Backfill job started, processing oldest items first. ETA ~3h for full reconciliation of the 2h backlog.
Eve (Support): Customer notification draft below. Please review quickly.

```
Subject: Temporary delay in usage updates and invoices
Hi <Customer name>,
We want to make you aware of an issue affecting usage visibility and invoice processing. Between 21:10 UTC and 23:30 UTC on 2026-03-14, our metering pipeline experienced transient errors that caused usage to be stale in the dashboard and may delay invoice generation for customers with upcoming billing windows.
What we're doing: we've mitigated the root cause, scaled read capacity, and are running a controlled backfill to reconcile missing usage. We expect full reconciliation within ~3 hours for most customers.
If you have an urgent billing deadline, reply to this note and we'll prioritize manual reconciliation for your account.
Sincerely,
Redwood Support
```

Product Ops: That's good. Shorten the top line for status page. Use the following status page snippet: ```We are investigating issues with usage visibility and invoice processing. Some customers may see stale usage data; invoices might be delayed. Mitigation in progress.```
Incident Bot: Status page draft published to staging: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/177555 - pending ops approval.
Oncall Pager: Handoff note for next oncall at 00:00 UTC: issue mitigated but backfill still in progress (ETA ~3h). If any invoice jobs still pending at handoff, escalate to Billing SRE.
Dmitri R: Reconciliation checklist for Billing team: 1) Confirm backfill processed for accounts with >$1k monthly spend, 2) Run reconciliation job to compute any undercharged periods, 3) Prepare manual invoices where automated pipeline misses deadline. Ticket: https://issues.redwood.ai/browse/BILL-458
Carla M: Adding an opt-in quick fix for dashboards to show "last processed at" vs realtime to avoid confusion while backfill runs. Small UI toggle, sending PR.
Eve (Support): I'm scheduling outbound emails to Enterprise contacts and a bulletin to self-serve customers on status page. Also creating a CS ticket template for customers who request manual recon.
Alice K: Post-mortem notes to capture: root cause (retry storm + DB throttling), monitoring gaps (no early signal for event queue length), mitigation timeline, and follow-ups (add queue length alert, retry jitter, and pre-warming read replicas before billing windows).
Ben T: Finance heads notified. Finance asked for an estimate of potential invoice delays and any likely underbilled amounts. I provided a preliminary estimate: <1% of total invoices affected, most delays are timing-only (not lost usage).
Product Ops: Final status update to publish in 45m with resolution details and customer guidance. Make sure status page notes the expected reconciliation ETA and contact link.
Oncall Pager: Marking this thread resolved for paging. Leaving open for post-incident reconciliation and customer comms. Next oncall (Dmitri) please acknowledge at handoff.
Dmitri R: Acknowledged. Will own backfill completion and final reconciliation report. I'll post the reconciliation summary when finished with line items for affected customers.
Eve (Support): Closing loop: created CUST-TEMPLATE-BILLING for manual invoices and assigned to billing ops.
Carla M: Logging runbook updates: add step to scale events-db proactively when queue > 10k and add a debounce to retry loops.
Incident Bot: Incident state changed to monitoring. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/metering-runbook.
Alice K: Great work team. Post-incident: let's do an eval of unit-cost impact from backfill and update Optimize recommendations to avoid cost surprises.
Product Ops: Thanks all — will convert notes here into a postmortem doc and customer comms playbook.
